analysisFocus.title: Analysis Focus
analysisFocus.description: Optional portfolio focus: General, Risk, Expansion, Churn, or Weekly Plan.

attentionFilter.title: Attention Filter
attentionFilter.description: Optional deterministic account filter: All, Risk, Renewal, Expansion, Churn, Quiet, or Escalation.

scopeFilter.title: Scope Filter
scopeFilter.description: Optional Account scope filter: Owned for the Account Manager book of business or Visible for all visible Accounts. Defaults to Owned.

searchText.title: Search Text
searchText.description: Optional Account name search text. Used only in Salesforce to select visible Accounts for analysis.

maxAccounts.title: Max Accounts
maxAccounts.description: Optional maximum number of Accounts to analyze. Defaults to 10 and caps at 25.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Optional safe correlation id for backend telemetry. Do not use Salesforce record ids.
